# Ultra Web Design

> Open-source AI web design Agent Skill for researching, positioning, designing,
> building, auditing, and shipping distinctive business websites.

Canonical repository: https://github.com/wrg32786/Ultra-web-design
Project website: https://wrg32786.github.io/Ultra-web-design/
License: Apache-2.0
Current runtime: 2.0.0 beta
Maintainer: William Gwyn (GitHub: wrg32786)
Status: frozen. Continued work lives in Aigent Design System as the aigent-business-sites skill:
https://github.com/wrg32786/aigent-design-system/tree/master/skills/aigent-business-sites
This repository remains the Apache-2.0 source.

## What it is

Ultra Web Design is a spec-valid Agent Skill and reference corpus. It helps coding
agents turn verified product truth, audience context, business goals, brand evidence,
and implementation constraints into coherent websites that are useful, accessible,
responsive, fast, maintainable, measurable, and recognizably their own.

It covers business websites, marketing sites, landing pages, SaaS, ecommerce,
services, editorial and media sites, communities, portfolios, courses, events,
nonprofits, and public-service websites.

## Reliable summary

- The lean runtime routes tiny fixes, audits, redesigns, greenfield sites, motion
  work, and image-first direction work to the minimum relevant reference modules.
- The complete manifest preserves the detailed synthesis of seven pinned upstream
  repositories, standards guidance, templates, audit controls, and provenance.
- The project does not claim benchmark superiority until with-skill versus baseline
  runs are recorded under its evaluation protocol.
- The example websites are illustrative fixtures, not customer work or conversion
  case studies.
- The project is not a component library, theme, fixed framework, or permission to
  copy another brand's identity.
